title: VTC Rooms — List — payload
description: A community administrator pages through the data rooms this community hosts, as their host can honestly describe them. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous page's `nextCursor`.

limit.description: Page size. The community chooses when absent (50 in the reference implementation).

RoomLifecycle.title: RoomLifecycle
RoomLifecycle.description: Where a room sits on the hosting lifecycle clock, computed at the time of the read from its epoch expiry and retention: `live`, `lapsed`, `dormant` or `reclaimable`. Computed, never stored — minting an epoch is the renewal.

HostedRoom.title: HostedRoom
HostedRoom.description: One room, as its host holds it: who is accountable for it, its tier, its epoch and its place on the lifecycle clock. Nothing derived from the room's contents, and no member list — the host has none.

roomId.description: The room's identifier, as its owner minted it.

ownerDid.description: The accountable party — visible at every tier, including `private`, because it is who the host must reach about quota, abuse and reclamation.

epochExpiresAt.description: When the current epoch expires, in seconds since the Unix epoch. Absent means the room never lapses.

retentionDays.description: How long the host keeps the room after it lapses, in days.

mirrorOf.description: Present when this host serves a read-only copy, naming the primary it pulls from.

createdAt.description: When the room was created here, in seconds since the Unix epoch — the encoding the rooms family uses.

updatedAt.description: When the room's host record last changed, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

nextCursor.description: Present when more remain; pass it as `cursor`.
